brief: Identify a conflict of interest in how an investment seller is compensated.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Sales Incentives"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "¿Quién gana con la venta?"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Quem ganha com a venda?"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify a conflict of interest in how an investment seller is compensated.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A seller’s pay can create an incentive that differs from your financial goal.
instruction.misconception: A recommendation is impartial simply because it sounds confident or comes from a friendly person.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: A seller earns more from one product than another. Ask how they are paid before treating their recommendation as neutral.
The bonus rewards selling A regardless of the customer’s outcome.
Different compensation can help explain a sales preference.
Disclosure explains an incentive; it does not erase it.
Per-trade payment can reward activity rather than useful outcomes.
Knowing the incentive does not replace evaluating the product.
Referral payments can influence which provider gets promoted.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
